task_definition: Multi-step arithmetic problem: On your FIRST turn, inspect the sandbox tools by running `print(add(25, 75))` and `print(diff(100, 40))` to verify their behavior. Do NOT call final_answer in the first turn. On the NEXT turn, after checking the printed observation, define the function `solve(n)` that uses add and diff to compute (n + 75) - 40, verify it with the test assertions, and submit the standalone solution code using final_answer(solution_code).
